description:
Get to Know Us

Horizon3 is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find, fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organizations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by IT Ops/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs.

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers & operators, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools and false positives, resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.

An Overview

We're looking for a Staff Attack Engineer to own Shared Attack Services: the production services that every NodeZero autonomous pentest depends on, no matter what it is attacking.

Every NodeZero operation runs in its own short-lived, isolated cloud environment. Some capabilities are too expensive, too sensitive, or too stateful to rebuild inside each one: GPU password cracking, lookups against tens of billions of breached credentials, callback infrastructure for blind exploits, and the APIs that let attack modules and other product teams reach them. Shared Attack Services builds and runs these as multi-region services in the various production markets.

You'll own these services end to end: architecture, code, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, observability, security reviews, and on-call. You'll decide what gets built next, write the design that gets it approved, and ship it to production.

This is a builder role on the offensive side of the house. You don't need to be a career pentester, but you need to care how attacks work, because the services you build decide what NodeZero can prove to a customer. If you want to own production systems outright, and want those systems to matter to how real attack paths get found and fixed, this is the seat.

What You’ll Do

  • Own a portfolio of shared attack services end to end, including GPU-accelerated password cracking, breached-credential lookup across tens of billions of records, out-of-band interaction (callback) infrastructure for blind exploits, and various other supporting services.

  • Design and build new shared capabilities that let attack modules and other product teams run work once, centrally, instead of inside every pentest environment.

  • Write production-grade Python services and the APIs and SDKs that other teams build on.

  • Run your services in production on AWS and Kubernetes (EKS) in the US, EU, and Australia, using infrastructure as code, GitLab CI/CD, and safe, repeatable deployments.

  • Bake in operational excellence from the start: monitors, dashboards, post-deploy smoke tests, rate limits, feature flags, and runbooks. Take part in the team on-call rotation.

  • Find and remove performance and scale limits in storage, memory, and compute, for example making a password audit of a one-million-user Active Directory domain finish in hours instead of days.

  • Turn ambiguous problems into plans: write design docs and decision records, break large initiatives into milestones, and keep stakeholders informed as the work ships.

  • Partner with attack engineers and the data, platform, security, and product teams. Act as the expert for your services in customer escalations and security reviews.

  • Mentor engineers, document what you build, and spread ownership so that no shared service depends on a single person.

What You’ll Bring

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience, with significant time building and running backend services or platforms in production.

  • Expert-level Python and a track record of shipping and maintaining production-quality services. You also know when to build a rapid proof-of-concept service to test an idea fast, and how to harden it for production once it proves its value.

  • Experience building and using agent-assisted development workflows in your daily engineering work.

  • Deep, hands-on experience with AWS (for example Lambda, DynamoDB, SQS, S3, KMS, IAM, and API Gateway) and Kubernetes, including Helm and autoscaling.

  • Experience designing distributed systems for reliability and scale, and explaining the tradeoffs between performance, cost, and maintainability.

  • Real operational ownership: you have been on call for services you built, led incident triage, and fixed the root cause afterward.

  • Infrastructure as code (Terraform or similar) and CI/CD experience, with GitLab CI a plus.

  • Observability experience: metrics, logs, traces, and alerts that catch problems before customers do (OpenTelemetry, Datadog, or similar).

  • The ability to work independently with little direction: you find the next important problem, write the plan, and ship it.

  • Strong written and verbal communication, including design docs that get decisions made and explanations that make sense to non-engineers.

  • Curiosity about offensive security and how real attacks work. You do not need to be a career pentester, but you need to want to learn the domain.

What Sets You Apart

  • Experience building platform or "X-as-a-service" capabilities that other engineering teams depend on every day.

  • Experience with password cracking (hashcat), GPU workloads, or large-scale credential and breach data.

  • Experience with high-volume storage and lookup patterns: sharded datastores, S3 range reads, bloom filters, Postgres, or similar.

  • Experience running multi-region, multi-tenant SaaS, including data residency requirements in the EU and other markets.

  • Hands-on offensive security experience: CTFs, Hack The Box, OSCP, or equivalent.

  • Experience with event-driven systems (Kafka, EventBridge, SQS) or workflow engines such as Temporal.

  • Experience with Go or Rust.

  • Experience building developer tooling that other engineers adopt.

  • Public contributions to the field: open-source tools, technical blog posts, conference talks, or patents.

Travel Required

We are a fully remote company, and this job may require up to 10% of travel to be successful.

Compensation and Values

At Horizon3, we believe that our people are our greatest asset, and our compensation philosophy reflects this core value. We are committed to fostering an environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and rewarded for their contributions. Our compensation structure is designed to be fair, competitive, and transparent, ensuring that every team member is recognized and compensated equitably across roles, levels, and locations.

In accordance with various State’s transparency regulations, we provide the following salary range information for this position:

  • Base salary range: $238,000 - $280,000. The exact salary will be determined based on the selected candidate’s location, qualifications, experience, and relevant skills.

  • Additional compensation: All full-time roles are eligible for an equity package in the form of stock options.

Perks of Horizon3

  • Inclusive Team: We value diversity and promote an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.

  • Growth Opportunities: Be part of a dynamic and growing team with numerous career development opportunities.

  • Innovative Culture: Work in a collaborative environment that encourages creativity and out-of-the-box thinking.

  • Hybrid & Remote Work: We embrace a mix of remote and hybrid work models depending on role and location, including our Chicago office, where some roles require regular in-office presence.

  • Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salary, equity and benefits. Our benefits include health, vision & dental insurance for you and your family, a flexible vacation policy, and generous parental leave.

You Belong Here

Horizon3 is not just an equal opportunity employer - we are a community that values diversity, equity, and inclusion as fundamental principles of our culture and success. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone feels welcome and respected, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, hair length or any other legally protected status by law.

Our commitment to diversity and inclusion means we strive to attract, develop, and retain a workforce that reflects the varied communities we serve. We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation and strengthen our ability to create cutting-edge cybersecurity solutions. At Horizon3, every team member is valued and supported in an environment that encourages personal and professional growth.

We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experiences, and we encourage all qualified individuals to apply. Come be a part of Horizon3, where your unique contributions are recognized, and your potential is limitless.

Other Duties

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Application Note

In any materials you submit, you may redact or remove age-identifying information such as age, date of birth, or dates of school attendance or graduation. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this information.
